title: Buy a National Parks annual pass
summary: Buy a digital annual pass to save on motor vehicle entrance fees at 45 NSW national parks and reserves.
intro:
Motor vehicle entrance fees are charged at 45 NSW national parks and reserves. If you're a regular visitor to any of these parks, you can save on the entry fees by buying a digital annual pass.

The 4 types of annual passes are:

Annual passes are digital, which means you will not receive a physical pass to display in your vehicle.

You can buy 1-year and 2-year passes online.
what_you_need: an email address that is not shared with someone else

how_to_steps.text: Follow the prompts to buy a pass.
call the National Parks Contact Centre on 1300 072 757, or

more_info.text: Your National Parks annual pass provides entry for the vehicle that is linked to your digital pass. You're not able to transfer passes between vehicles.
If you have more than one vehicle you'll need to choose which one to link to your digital pass.
